scope: Corollary 7.1 of the manuscript “The Campana–Peternell conjecture in dimension six” (preprints/The-Campana-Peternell-conjecture-in-dimension-six-September-25-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 067 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 c6c7151f9581ddd5), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 21. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let X be a smooth connected complex projective Fano variety with nef tangent bundle and 1 ≤ dimC X ≤ 6. Then X admits a positive Kähler–Einstein metric. More precisely, with the Ricci-form convention ρ(ω) = −i∂ ¯ ∂ log det(gab̄), there is a Kähler form ω such that ρ(ω) = ω, [ω] = 2πc1(−KX).
